audit.description: Changed production code in src/clickgen/configparser.py imports the real cattrs package, creates cattrs.Converter(), registers a structure hook, and uses _converter.structure(...) to construct ThemeSection, CursorSection, and ClickgenConfig values. The previous source import from attr was removed and replaced with stdlib dataclasses.dataclass, while static and dynamic evidence report no source imports from production repo code. Dynamic target evidence resolves cattrs from site-packages and target_local_spec_count is 0, so there is no indication of a local fake target provider.
evidence: Unified diff: src/clickgen/configparser.py adds import cattrs and _converter = cattrs.Converter()
Unified diff: src/clickgen/configparser.py replaces from attr import dataclass with from dataclasses import dataclass
Unified diff: parse_theme_section, parse_cursors_section, and parse_*_file functions call _converter.structure(...)
Static anti-cheat: src/clickgen/configparser.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false
Dynamic anti-cheat: first_target_events_from_repo shows cattrs imported from site-packages/cattrs/__init__.py at src/clickgen/configparser.py line 9
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses cattrs Converter and structure APIs
Changed production code no longer imports attr or attrs
Source imports observed only from dependencies, not repo production code
Target package resolves to installed site-packages with no local target provider
